[SWS_DM_01115] Data reporting for event combination on retrieval
⌈
If DiagnosticCommonProps.typeOfEventCombinationSupported is set to
eventCombinationOnRetrieval, the DM shall return the event related data of all
assigned events to UDS by concatenating the data of all events into one response for
the same DTC.
⌋
